name: Bossa Nova
description: Classic AABA jazz-samba form — syncopated nylon-guitar clave, extended ii-V-I harmony, and a chromatic Jobim-style passing chord in the bridge.

defaults.concept: Bossa nova — a syncopated nylon-string 'violao' clave pattern (thumb on 1 and 3, fingers picking chord tones on the syncopated off-beats), soft brushed drums or rim clicks, warm upright bass, and breathy, intimate vocals. Lush extended 7th/9th chords throughout — plain triads never appear. Always straight eighth notes, precise and unhurried, never swung.

slots.label: Solo Clave
slots.purpose: FEEL: Intimate, unhurried, the room settling. PRODUCTION NOTE: Nylon guitar alone, dry and close-mic'd, no reverb yet — let the clave pattern itself be the whole introduction.
slots.groove: Solo nylon-string clave — thumb alternates bass notes on 1 and 3 while fingers pick syncopated chord tones on the off-beat 16ths; strictly straight eighths.

slots.label: The A Section
slots.purpose: FEEL: Conversational, warm, a breath-close vocal. PRODUCTION NOTE: Vocal sits just above a whisper in the mix, with guitar and upright bass given equal presence — nothing should compete for attention.
slots.groove: Full clave locks in with a soft brushed snare or rim-click on the 'and' of 2; upright bass walks gently on 1 and 3.

slots.label: The B Section Lift
slots.purpose: FEEL: A gentle harmonic surprise, wistful. TRICK: Bring in a soft flute or vibraphone doubling the melody's highest notes to mark the section without raising the overall energy.
slots.groove: Same clave continues under the harmonic lift; the cymbal wash opens slightly to mark the section without breaking the pocket.

slots.label: The A Section, Improvised
slots.purpose: FEEL: Effortless, exploratory. PRODUCTION NOTE: The rhythm section holds completely steady while the solo instrument is given the only real freedom in the arrangement — the contrast is the point.
slots.groove: Clave and bass hold steady while a lead instrument (flute, sax, or nylon guitar) improvises over the A-section changes.

slots.label: Vamp and Fade
slots.purpose: FEEL: Settling, unresolved but at peace. TRICK: Let the guitar clave repeat and slowly recede rather than resolving hard to a final chord — the room, not the harmony, ends the song.
slots.groove: Guitar clave alone, vamping on the tonic, receding in volume until it fades rather than cutting.
